canon.ref: characters.json#/skills/122101+122102+122103+122104 + bonus_abilities (Fiery Wheel, Demon Quell, True Sunder)
canon.note: Bladeborne Quake (122102) L10: #1 = 120% main, #2 = 60% adjacent, heals #3 = 30% ATK + 200. Earthbind, Etherbreak (122103): consumes #8 = 120 of her 240 Max Energy; Parry lasts until end of the next ally/enemy turn; Intuit: Slash = #1 = 220% main, #6 = 110% adjacent; Intuit: Cull = same base + #4 = 6 random instances of #7 = 72%; Slash/Cull count as Ultimate AND Follow-Up damage but NOT as using an Ultimate (canon notes). Flashforge (122104) L10: Counter = 120% main, 60% adjacent, +15 Energy. Galespin Summersault (122101) L6 = 100%. BA True Sunder: Counter grants ATK +30% for 1 turn.

fixtures.env: Yunli E0 solo vs 3 Physical-weak Elite dummies (Lv120, 6M HP, 300 Toughness), 3 cycles, seed 7

requirements.claim: Earthbind, Etherbreak (122103) is Yunli's Ultimate action (3 casts in the fixture; 240 Max Energy allows double-Ultimate charges).
Bladeborne Quake (122102) is her Skill action (3 casts in the fixture).
Galespin Summersault (122101) is her Basic ATK action (1 cast in the fixture).

Every triggered Parry Counter launches Intuit: Slash Blast first, main-target hit — 2 Parry counters in the fixture, 2 main hits. (The UNTRIGGERED fallback Intuit: Slash does not fire here: each Parry window is consumed by a real counter.)
Intuit: Slash deals adjacent damage (#6 = 50% of main) — 2 procs x 2 adjacent = 4.
Intuit: Cull's random instances (#4 = 6 per proc) land 12 times in the fixture (2 Cull procs, one per triggered Parry Counter).
Bladeborne Quake hits its main target once per cast (3 casts).
Bladeborne Quake is a Blast attack: both adjacent enemies per cast (3 x 2 = 6).
Flashforge (122104) Counters trigger 7 times in the fixture: all 9 enemy attacks against Yunli, minus the 2 consumed by triggered Parry Counters.
Flashforge Counter hits adjacent enemies (7 x 2 = 14).
Galespin Summersault hits its single target once (1 cast).
The Basic ATK regenerates 1 Skill Point (1 cast).
The Skill costs 1 Skill Point per cast (3 casts = 3 SP).
Bladeborne Quake restores HP equal to #3 = 30% ATK + #4 = 200 per cast — 3 self-heals in the fixture.
Intuit: Slash main multiplier (122103 #1) is 220% of ATK at L10.
Intuit: Slash adjacent multiplier (122103 #6) is 110% of ATK at L10.
Intuit: Cull's random instance multiplier (122103 #7) is 72% of ATK at L10.
Bladeborne Quake L10 (122102 #1) main multiplier is 120% of ATK.
Bladeborne Quake L10 (122102 #2) adjacent multiplier is 60% of ATK.
Flashforge L10 (122104 #1) Counter main multiplier is 120% of ATK.
Flashforge L10 (122104 #2) Counter adjacent multiplier is 60% of ATK.
Galespin Summersault at the engine's default Basic Lv6 (122101 L6) totals 100% of ATK.
Over the fixture Yunli regenerates exactly 320 Energy (ENERGY_GAIN summed by target; 7 Flashforge counters +15 each plus the Ultimate use itself, minus 240 Max Energy ceiling).

BA Demon Quell applies DMG −20% for the WHOLE Parry window: added with the Ultimate, removed the moment the Parry is used by a Counter or the window closes untriggered (122103). 3 applications, one per Ultimate.
BA True Sunder: after each Counter, ATK +30% for 1 turn (10 applications in the fixture).
The Intuit counter readiness state after an Ultimate lasts 1 turn in the engine.
Flashforge Counters react off-turn: the first Counter resolves after the first Skill damage.
Intuit damage counts as both Ultimate DMG and Follow-Up ATK DMG (122103 Notes): its hits are ult-typed and carry the Follow-Up tag (triggering it is NOT considered using an Ultimate).
